symptom: Pinned main workflow retains a daily-retention-snapshot job with `if: always() && needs.guard.outputs.ok == 'true'`, a JST 23 time gate, and a conditional CAS append to the automation branch. The job does not require run-one-task success. After the Draft PR's early-exit-3 legacy task denial, a successful owner/main guard could therefore still permit the independent retention job to attempt a sanitized snapshot write at JST 23. A separate workflow_run retained-state audit is also conclusion-agnostic but read-only. This is conditional static reachability, not an observed dispatch, write, or production incident.
lesson: Fail-closing a deprecated task executable does not automatically disable workflow-level follow-up jobs. Evaluate `always()` and `needs` predicates, time gates, token permissions, and independent workflow_run triggers separately from the task process exit and primary job conclusion.
guardrail: Do not claim the legacy workflow inert solely from CLI exit 3 or green PR CI. Before an operational deprecation decision, obtain owner review of the main manual workflow's conditional daily retention CAS writer, always-on status/commit steps, and conclusion-agnostic read-only audit. Preserve existing CAS/path allowlists, do not dispatch the workflow or protected N2 for diagnosis, and do not alter canonical intent or production.
